useCases.title: Datatilsynet breach reporting
useCases.value: Tracks breach assessment milestones and Datatilsynet notification timestamps for supervisory evidence.

useCases.title: Altinn-based data handling compliance
useCases.value: Monitors API usage to national digital channels for purpose limitation and logging of national identifier references.

useCases.title: National ID number protection
useCases.value: Detects national identifier patterns in application and web logs to trigger immediate redaction workflows.

useCases.title: Sector-specific processing rules
useCases.value: Maps processing activities to sector codes via lookup to evidence sector-specific obligations.

useCases.title: Cross-border transfer to non-EU/EEA
useCases.value: Validates transfer tickets include documented safeguards before data leaves the EEA boundary.

useCases.title: Personopplysningsloven §14 — automated-decision inventory and human-review evidence
useCases.value: §14 (mirroring GDPR Art.22) requires safeguards for automated individual decisions; a low review rate triggers an immediate DPO review.

useCases.title: Personopplysningsloven §2 — territorial/material scope tagging of data flows
useCases.value: §2 defines when Norwegian data-protection law applies; missing scope tagging is a silent governance failure and the UC catches it.
